# Tag Janitor

Tag Janitor is a Zendesk Support app that audits the full inventory of ticket tags in a
Zendesk instance — ticket count, closed-ticket share and last use for every tag, not just
the top 100 of the last 60 days — shows which triggers, automations, macros, views, SLA
policies, ticket fields and organizations still reference each tag, then renames, merges or
deletes tags behind a preview that states what Zendesk will reject.

The app has no backend, no account and no signup: it is pure HTML and JavaScript inside the
Zendesk App Framework, and no helpdesk data leaves the customer's own Zendesk instance.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tag-janitor.app.mintapis.com/): what the app does, how it works, FAQ
- [Guides](https://tag-janitor.app.mintapis.com/guides/): practical notes on Zendesk ticket tag hygiene
- [Auditing Zendesk ticket tags](https://tag-janitor.app.mintapis.com/guides/auditing-zendesk-ticket-tags/): per-tag metrics and how to build a full tag inventory
- [Tags referenced by triggers, views and macros](https://tag-janitor.app.mintapis.com/guides/tags-referenced-by-triggers-views-macros/): where tag references hide and how to build the tag-to-rule reverse index
- [Planning a safe bulk tag cleanup](https://tag-janitor.app.mintapis.com/guides/safe-bulk-tag-cleanup/): ordering, batching, previews and rollback for large cleanups
- [Privacy policy](https://tag-janitor.app.mintapis.com/privacy.html)
- [Imprint](https://tag-janitor.app.mintapis.com/imprint.html)
